title: Saag Paneer
description: Golden cubes of paneer in a smooth, gently spiced spinach sauce with garlic, ginger and a little cream.

image.alt: A bowl of creamy spinach with golden paneer cubes

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and brown the paneer on a couple of sides, {time 4-5 min}. Set aside.

Add the rest of the oil and the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for {time 30 sec}. Cook the onion until golden, {time 8 min}, then add the garlic, ginger and chile for {time 1 min}. Stir in the coriander and garam masala.
Add the spinach a handful at a time with the water and salt, stirring until it’s all wilted, {time 4-5 min}.
Blend until fairly smooth, then return it to the pan. Stir in the cream and the paneer and simmer gently until heated through, {time 3-4 min}.

notes: Frozen chopped spinach (about 1 lb, thawed and squeezed) works well.
Extra-firm tofu can replace the paneer.
